releases.name: v1.9.0 — Standalone gemini-app-cli, GetUserStatus Provenance & Gateway Hardening
releases.body:
## Highlights

### 1. New Standalone Package: `gemini-app-cli@0.1.0`
Zero-dependency non-interactive Unix CLI (`gemini-app` / `gemini-app-cli`) over native Google HTTP/2 — no MCP server process, no interactive REPL, no shell execution, and zero external npm dependencies.
- **One-shot & streaming commands**: `ask`, `search` (Google Search grounding with citations), `quota`, `models`, `login [--remote] [--accept-terms]`, `status`, and `logout`.
- **Validated JSON Schema Structured Outputs (`--schema <file|json>`)**: Enforces strict JSON Schema output with bounded single-retry protocol recovery across both direct OAuth HTTP/2 and optional `GEMINI_GATEWAY_URL` gateway modes.
- **File & image attachments**: Repeatable `-f`/`--file` (strict UTF-8 bounded text) and `-i`/`--image` (up to 16 local PNG/JPEG/WebP images), plus atomic `-o`/`--output` file writes and `--json` output.
- **Opt-in read-only workspace harness (`--tools readonly` / `read,grep,find,ls`)**: Multi-turn codebase inspection with `--cwd`, `--max-turns`, and `--verbose` — polynomial-time non-backtracking `**/` glob matching, UTF-16-safe literal `grep`, case-folded secret-path denylist, batch `tool_call` ID normalization, and hard 32 KiB / 256 KiB output & overall deadline budgets.
- **Bundled Agent Skill**: Ships with `SKILL.md` for bash-enabled coding agents that prefer CLI over MCP, plus updated trilingual READMEs and 5-logo overview banner.

### 2. `GetUserStatus` + `cap529` Subscription Provenance & Free-Account Routing Safety
- Switched live subscription tier detection to `GetUserStatus` + `cap529` with strict `subscriptionRpc: "GetUserStatus"` provenance across the gateway and all standalone extensions.
- Excluded Free accounts from `gemini-neon` routing and invalidated stale pre-Free / downgraded Neon verification snapshots so Free accounts no longer enter Neon failover loops.
- Hardened 429 quota/throttle handling and Admin UI throttle display.

### 3. Gateway Hardening & Admin Console UI Updates
- Hardened terminal completion outcomes, admission budgets, SSE usage reporting, Responses tool namespaces, and linear $O(n)$ gRPC frame assembly.
- Added a high-contrast GitHub icon topbar link and dismissible active-workspace star prompt in the trilingual Admin Console.

## Extension Package Versions
- `pi-gemini-app@0.1.15`
- `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.11`
- `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.7`
- `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.6`
- `gemini-app-cli@0.1.0` *(new)*

## Full Changelog
https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.8.3...v1.9.0

releases.name: v1.8.3 — Streaming Tool-Call Revision Rebasing (#11), Instant Inline-Backtick Preview (#10), and Zero-Call Hallucinated
releases.body:
### Streaming Tool-Call Revision Rebasing (Fixes #11), Instant Inline-Backtick Streaming Preview (Fixes #10), and Zero-Call Hallucinated Tool-Result Recovery

Updated standalone extensions: `pi-gemini-app@0.1.14`, `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.10`, `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.6`, `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.5`.

- **Deferred Tool-Call Emission & Same-ID Snapshot Revision Rebasing (Fixes #11)** (`src/native-provider.mjs`, `src/gateway/app.mjs`, `extensions/pi/stream.js`, `extensions/opencode/fetch.js`):
  - Enabled `deferToolCalls: true` across the HTTP Gateway, Pi/OpenClaw (`extensions/pi/stream.js`), and OpenCode (`extensions/opencode/fetch.js`) so parsed caller tool calls are held until turn completion (`END_STREAM` / `modelComplete`), verified `postToolIdleStall` / `NATIVE_TURN_TIMEOUT`, or salvageable `TOOL_ERRORS`. Because clients never execute tool calls before turn completion, deferring adds zero turn latency while preventing draft no-op calls from executing.
  - Added `tryRebaseLive()` for same-`responseId` cumulative snapshot revisions that preserve already-delivered visible text and published calls, replacing retracted draft tool calls cleanly instead of failing with `NON_MONOTONIC_NATIVE_RESPONSE` — while keeping revisions of already-shown text or missing/changed `responseId` strictly fail-closed.
  - Hardened edge transitions: bound `modelComplete` and deferred call release strictly to accepted snapshots (`snapshotAccepted`), salvaged already-validated Call A when a trailing Call B has broken JSON followed by reset/timeout, and deferred temporary mid-revision `TOOL_ERRORS` inside `tryRebaseLive()` when the delivered prefix remains intact so a subsequent same-ID frame can repair it cleanly.
- **Immediate Inline-Backtick Streaming Preview & Incremental O(n) Scanner (Fixes #10)** (`src/tool-protocol.mjs`):
  - Fixed `safePendingPreview()` holding back trailing lines without `\n` at the first single backtick `` ` `` (which previously froze visible text before inline code for up to 45 seconds during `postOutputToolIdleMs` waits). Ordinary 1–2 backtick inline code now streams immediately while potential `tool_call` fence openings (` ``` `) remain safely held.
  - Replaced repeated per-chunk trailing-line rescans with a localized O(n) incremental cursor inside `safePendingPreview()` (64 KiB single-line stress benchmarks reduced from ~174–230 ms to ~3.5–5.6 ms).
- **Zero-Call Hallucinated `[Caller tool result]` Wire-Block Guard & Automatic Recovery** (`src/tool-protocol.mjs`, `src/native-provider.mjs`, `src/gateway/automatic-recovery.mjs`, `extensions/pi/stream.js`, `extensions/opencode/fetch.js`):
  - Unified `classifyCallerResultWire()` with `leadingWhitespace` buffering and `flush({ interrupted })` so models that echo synthetic `[Caller tool result] {"tool_call_id":...}` blocks with zero prior `tool_call` fences are caught immediately, cancelled upstream, and automatically recovered via targeted `MALFORMED_TOOL_CALL` (`hallucinated_caller_result`) guidance instead of leaking synthetic transcript text and halting agent loops.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.8.2...v1.8.3

releases.name: v1.8.2 — Hotfix: Prevent Premature 2s Cancel on Empty Pre-Text Frames
releases.body:
## Hotfix

### Restore `hasText` Guard on `post_complete` Grace Timer
- **Fixes a `v1.8.1` regression on long-thinking `gemini-neon` turns** (`src/native-provider.mjs`):
  - Restored `facts.modelComplete && facts.hasText` in `selectIdleDeadline()` and removed the `v1.8.1` empty-text `post_complete` cutoff.
  - Real Gemini App streams emit intermediate pre-text frames carrying `field 9 = 1` (`completed = true`) with empty display text during deep thinking and pause `> 2s` before emitting the visible answer. Arming the 2-second `post_complete` timer before any visible text arrived prematurely cancelled healthy turns with `INCOMPLETE_NATIVE_RESPONSE` → `GENERATION_FAILED`.
  - All `v1.8.1` fixes for #8 (Responses replay compatibility) and #9 (`postOutputToolIdleMs`, bounded thought-progress tracking, ordered non-incremental delivery, incremental flush sink error propagation) remain intact.

### Companion Extension Versions
- `pi-gemini-app@0.1.13`
- `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.9`
- `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.5`
- `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.4`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.8.1...v1.8.2

releases.name: v1.8.1 — Responses Replay Compatibility, Tool-Aware Idle Patience & OpenCode V2
releases.body:
## Highlights

### Standard OpenAI Responses Mid-Conversation Replay Compatibility (Fixes #8)
- **`message.phase`**: Accepted on `assistant` messages (`"commentary"`, `"final_answer"`, `null`) and stripped cleanly, coalescing interleaved assistant commentary between parallel tool calls so it never trips `PENDING_TOOL_CALLS`.
- **Replayed `type: "reasoning"` items**: Validated under a dedicated `16 MiB` stripped-reasoning budget and transparently stripped without flushing deferred tool images; `usage.input_tokens` / `prompt_tokens` are now derived directly from the single-source canonical prompt so stripped `encrypted_content` and JSON escapes never inflate token estimates.
- **Historical paired `custom_tool_call` / `custom_tool_call_output`**: Accepted as read-only history replay (wrapped as `{"input":"..."}` with `<= 256 KiB` pre/post-serialization bounds, call-kind / `name` / `namespace` / duplicate-`call_id` linkage checks, and namespace alias reservation), while active `tools` declaring `type: "custom"` remain fail-closed (`400 UNSUPPORTED_TOOL_TYPE`).
- **Unified SDK replay metadata & fail-closed boundaries**: Consistent handling of `id`, `status`, `caller`, `async`, and `function_call_output.{name, namespace}`; type-first `400 UNSUPPORTED_INPUT_TYPE` for opaque `compaction`, `additional_tools`, and `configuration_update`; `maxPromptBytes` enforced before `request-resumption` cache lookup.

### Tool-Aware Long-Context Idle Patience & Bounded Thought Progress (Fixes #9)
- **`postOutputToolIdleMs` (`45s` default)**: Applied exclusively to `tool_choice: "auto"` turns awaiting an optional tool call (`!hasParsedCalls && !streamingTool`), preventing premature `15s` cancellation of `< 2,048B` pre-tool preambles on 180K–450K long-context turns while leaving `END_STREAM` (`0ms`), `modelComplete` (`2s`), `postToolIdleMs` (`6s`), and plain/non-tool turns (`15s`) untouched (and cleanly inheriting `postOutputIdleMs: null`).
- **Bounded thought-progress tracking**: Tracks `ModelResponse` field `12` + repeated field `16` `nativeThoughtBytes` with one-shot post-text rebase (duplicate/oscillating frames never extend timers) and a finite `maxPostOutputThoughtHoldMs` cap (`135s` default) anchored on `lastTextProgressAt` so turns never hang to `timeoutMs`.
- **Stream completion & delivery hardening**: Arms `post_complete` grace for empty/thoughts-only `modelComplete: true` turns missing `END_STREAM` (exiting cleanly as `INCOMPLETE_NATIVE_RESPONSE` with `wireEnded: false`), preserves exact splitter item order on non-incremental `response_format` stalls, and propagates flush sink errors instead of marking undelivered calls as benign stalls.

### OpenCode V2 (`./server`) + V1 (`.`) Dual Plugin Support
- Added zero-dependency OpenCode V2 server plugin entrypoint (`exports["./server"]`) alongside V1 (`exports["."]`) with OAuth connect/cancel, Free vs Pro tier gating, and streaming SSE + tool calling.

### Companion Extension Versions
- `pi-gemini-app@0.1.12`
- `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.8`
- `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.4`
- `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.3`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShawTim/gemini-app2api/compare/v1.8.0...v1.8.1

releases.name: v1.8.0 — Native Windows Support, Strict Responses Proxy Fix & State-Machine Refactor
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Native Windows (`win32`) Support & `windows-latest` CI (Fixes #5)**:
  - Kernel-backed single-instance locking on Windows via libuv `UV_FS_O_EXLOCK` (`dwShareMode = 0`) on a persistent `.state.lock` handle with an immediate fail-closed `EBUSY` self-probe (zero PID-reclamation races or PID-reuse lockouts).
  - Locale-independent SID-based `icacls.exe` ACL hardening (`*S-1-5-18`, `*S-1-5-32-544`, and current local `S-1-5-*` / Entra ID `S-1-12-1-*` user SID), bounded `renameSync` retry on transient Defender `EPERM`/`EACCES`/`EBUSY`, `SIGBREAK` handling, and `pathToFileURL` + Winsock env fixes in `scripts/run-current-contract.mjs`.
  - Verified on GitHub Actions `windows-latest` (`current-contract` + `windows-native` NTFS lock, cross-process contention, forced-kill recovery, 4-way race, `.env`, and loopback `/health` checks).
- **Strict Responses Proxy Compatibility (Fixes #6)**:
  - Qualified usable `POST /v1/responses` SSE `response.completed` events now always emit `response.error: null` while preserving `incomplete: true`, `incomplete_details: { reason: "upstream_interrupted", code }`, and `res.incomplete = true` (preventing resumption cache retention)—stopping reconnect loops on strict OpenAI Responses proxies (e.g., Codex Desktop via Cockpit Tools).
  - `response.failed`, `response.incomplete`, and non-streaming partial responses keep `error` intact.
- **Sticky Session & Image Blob Cache Preservation**:
  - Verified `post_tool` and `post_output` idle stalls no longer poison `session.lastFailure` or thrash per-account image `blobCache` on subsequent turns; `X-Gemini-Recovery-Errors` is only emitted on actual retry attempts.
- **State-Machine Refactor & Strict JSON Recovery**:
  - Closed, privacy-safe `TOOL_JSON_REASONS` syntax subcodes in `parseBoundedJson()` with targeted recovery directives appended at the **prompt tail** and 2 uncommitted `tool_protocol` retries across Gateway, Pi, and OpenCode.
  - Converged `response-delivery.mjs` onto monotonic 4-state `wirePhase`, replaced O(N^2) per-frame idle probing in `native-provider.mjs` with O(1) `classifyIdleSnapshot()` + pure `selectIdleDeadline()`, unified `pool.mjs` retry planning in pure `planRetry()`, fixed OpenCode `post_tool` stall handling, and added committed multi-call tail salvage in Pi/OpenCode.
  - Added synthetic 150K-token HTTP/2 adversarial long-context suite (`test/gateway-long-context-adversarial.test.mjs`).

## Extension Packages
- `pi-gemini-app@0.1.11`
- `openclaw-gemini-app@0.1.7`
- `mcp-gemini-app@0.1.2`
- `opencode-gemini-app@0.1.2`
